title: Day 20 Intelligence
subtitle: Commonwealth rebuttal experts and criminal responsibility
one_liner: Day 20 narrowed the dispute from the presence of mental illness to psychosis, the reported command hallucination, retained control, and the provenance of expert premises.
purpose: Preserve what Heilbrun's completed testimony and Saathoff's opening testimony changed in the working understanding of the case.
what_changed: A Commonwealth expert accepted mental disease or defect while opining that legal awareness and behavioral control remained; several source-review and independently testable timeline issues emerged.
